title: Follow the Request
summary: Resolve a synthetic local hostname and inspect HTTP.
description: This mission uses a local DNS responder on UDP port 5353 and a local HTTP endpoint. It does not query public DNS. Resolve the training name, check the HTTP response, and record the status.
learning_objectives: Distinguish DNS names from IP addresses
Inspect HTTP response headers and status

workspace_seed.network-notes.txt: Local DNS simulation: 127.0.0.1:5353/UDP. HTTP training target: 127.0.0.1:8080.
workspace_seed.training_service.py:
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        payload=b"RedPanda local request target\n"
        self.send_response(200); self.send_header("Content-Type","text/plain"); self.send_header("X-Training-Target","local-only"); self.send_header("Content-Length",str(len(payload))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(payload)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args): pass
HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1",8080),Handler).serve_forever()

offline_hints.content: DNS is a naming lookup; HTTP is a separate application protocol. This mission simulates the resolver locally.
